toegepas.voor: Hy het in 1944 by die ANC
toegepas.na: Mandela het in 1944 by die ANC
toegepas.rede_vinder: The block opens with 'Hy' right after a block whose subjects are the government and the groups, so naming Mandela makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: The block opens with 'Hy' straight after a block whose last subjects are the government (referred to as 'Sy plan') and the groups; Mandela is not named anywhere in that block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Mandela at the start of the block removes a first-reading stumble over who 'Hy' is, without changing the claim or touching a protected word.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Met protes help' reads wooden; helping with protests takes the countable plural in natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'met protes gehelp' is wooden, and 'met protes' is also a fixed expression for 'under protest', so the phrase can be misread as 'helped reluctantly'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'met proteste gehelp' is the natural countable form and removes the misreading while saying the same thing.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'n Ander' means 'a different' one; the sense of 'another, a further' trial is 'nog 'n' in Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n Ander hofsaak' (a different case) is natural Afrikaans and accurate here; switching the determiner to 'nog 'n' changes the nuance to 'one more' without a fault to fix.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Reaching an agreement in negotiation is 'ooreenkom'; 'saamstem' means sharing an opinion.
na_skrywer.fout: In the [begrip] definition 'saamstem' (share an opinion) is imprecise for the outcome of negotiating, which is reaching an agreement; it also sits close to the protected 'saam stem' (vote together) in the lesson, which a Grade 4 reader may confuse.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is real, but it rewords a glossary definition, which only the writer may change.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: werk tot voordeel van ander en nie van homself nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: werk tot voordeel van ander en nie tot sy eie voordeel nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Tot voordeel ... nie van homself nie' is an incomplete parallel; the idiom needs 'tot sy eie voordeel'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original is a clear, grammatical ellipsis ('nie [tot voordeel] van homself nie'); the proposal only makes it longer.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Gewone mense kan dit ook doen
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Hulle stories behoort aan mense oral en nie net aan hulle eie lande nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Hulle stories behoort aan die hele wêreld en nie net aan hulle eie lande nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Aan mense oral' is awkward and does not parallel 'lande'; 'die hele wêreld' keeps the meaning and balances the contrast.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'aan mense oral' is natural Afrikaans and was written to a curriculum order for a value statement; 'aan die hele wêreld' can read as a claim of reach, so the meaning would move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: After 'manier' a verb takes the 'om te' infinitive; 'manier van regeer' is colloquial.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'n manier van regeer' is an established Afrikaans construction (like 'manier van doen'), and the change to a glossary definition would put 'regeer' twice in quick succession.
